design_fidelity.note: Matches design M5.1 and M5.7: every Sol row carries citation keys that resolve; every alpha Cen number is measured|inferred(relation)|assumed(reason); statuses follow the pinned archive snapshot; alpha Cen B b is absent; A b is one labelled orbit family; no modelled discs (no alpha Cen planet has both a measured radius and albedo). Deviations, all defensible and recorded: 12 moons (the design names 12 and miscounts 11); DE440 GM instead of 'IAU 2015 nominal' (the nominal set only defines Sun/Earth/Jupiter, and the test shows DE440 agrees with them to 1e-6); Lambert assumed for Uranus/Neptune with its own citation key; Adams arcs deferred to M5.2b; PDS/NSSDC ring edges. -2 for two unrecorded ones: (a) the design asks for tau 'from published occultation profiles ... averaged per region' and the data uses PDS/NSSDC range midpoints (log midpoint for decade ranges), a coarser proxy, fine for R1 but not what the doc says; (b) provenance nits in acen.ail: Proxima c's 1928 +- 20 d and 1.489 +- 0.049 AU are the refined values adopted by Kervella et al. 2020 / the archive, not Damasso 2020's published 1900 (+96/-82) d and 1.48 +- 0.08 AU, and the Chen & Kipping Terran relation is R = 1.008 M^0.279, so dropping the 1.008 makes the inferred radii 0.8 % small (labelled inferred, so honest, but the named relation is incomplete).

feedback_summary: PASS 89/100. Fix before merge: untrack sim/data/.ailang/cache (36 files) and extend .gitignore. Recommended, not blocking: Kepler's-third-law and p_V-bound checks to guard a, e, GM and albedo; cite Proxima c's digits to their actual source; soften the 'five table errors' claim to one (Uranus).
notes: Every Sol number spot-checked (Standish 2a/2b for all eight planets; IAU 2015 poles, W, radii and periodic terms for the Sun, planets and twelve moons; DE440 GM for 21 bodies; Mallama p_V; JPL rows for the Moon, Galileans, Mimas, Titan and Triton; PDS Saturn edges; NSSDC Jupiter, Uranus and Neptune rings and moon albedos) is right. The Triton node sign is right by physics (cos i < 0). The alpha Cen data follows the design's honesty rules and the live archive. The strict VM and the interpreter agree, and the cited register-allocator workaround is reproducible and reported upstream.
